description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultHtmlDisplay class, which handles rendering shapes into HTML content within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It manages shape binding, event invocation, and shape processing logic.

classes.name: DefaultHtmlDisplay
classes.description: Implements IHtmlDisplay to render shapes into HTML content, managing shape binding, events, and wrappers.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Main method to process and render a shape into HTML content asynchronously.

methods.name: GetShapeDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the shape descriptor based on shape type from the shape table.

methods.name: GetShapeBindingAsync
methods.description: Finds the appropriate shape binding for a given shape type and alternates.

methods.name: TryGetParentShapeTypeName
methods.description: Helper to get parent shape type by removing the last segment after '__'.

methods.name: ProcessAsync
methods.description: Executes the shape binding asynchronously to produce HTML content.
